title: Occupational Biomechanics Dataset Entry
description: Metadata record for one dataset in the catalog. Aligned with schema.org/Dataset where possible; extended with occupational-biomechanics fields.

id.description: Unique slug, also the filename. Lowercase, hyphenated.

status.description: open = publicly downloadable; restricted = available under a data-use agreement; coming_soon = planned, not yet released.

sample.description: true for placeholder/example entries shipped with the template. Remove or set false for real records.

url.description: Canonical landing page or DOI resolver. The catalog links out; it does not rehost.

license.description: SPDX-style id or short name, e.g. CC-BY-4.0. Datasets keep their own license.

tasks.description: Controlled vocabulary. 'mmh' = manual materials handling (umbrella term).

exoskeleton.description: Present when the record is exoskeleton-relevant. Omit entirely for datasets with no exoskeleton connection.

role.description: evaluation = a device was worn and its effect measured; control_input = collected to develop or control an exoskeleton, no device worn during capture.

devices.description: Device names as the source reports them, e.g. 'Laevo V2.5 (Laevo Exoskeletons)'.

body_region.description: Body region the device supports (or the target region for control_input records).

actuation.description: Actuation principle of the device(s) evaluated.

comparison.description: Study design in one line, e.g. 'with vs. without device, within-subject'.

outcomes.description: Outcome families reported, so evaluations can be compared on what they actually measured.

publications.description: Papers reporting on this dataset, when more than the access link is worth listing (e.g. one cohort, several analyses). Rendered as a Publications section on the detail page.

citation.description: Short citation, e.g. 'Kim et al. (2021). Title. Am. J. Ind. Med. 64(11):905-914'.

url.description: Landing page when there is no DOI.

note.description: One line on what this paper reports from the dataset.

load.description: Handled load / task intensity, e.g. '5-15 kg boxes'.

equipment.description: Capture systems, e.g. 'OptiTrack (12 cam), Delsys Trigno EMG'.

sampling.description: Sampling rates per modality in Hz (video in fps).
